The analysis does not note that the export cannot determine whether the 58 ChunkLoadError users overlap with the 44 in the 401 cluster.
No inference about session expiry or unhandled 401 rejection is made.
No specific two-slot recommendation is given; the analysis offers only generic workflow steps.
BANKUI-2F0 is not placed at or near the top of any priority list.
The analysis does not assign separate causes or fixes to the four undefined-property issues.
No user counts are summed across issues.
BANKUI-1A7 is not mentioned at all, so it is not stated as fixed or needing no action.
The 401 issues are not described as an attack, intrusion, or security breach.
BANKUI-5D6 and BANKUI-1A7 are not grouped with the 401 cluster.
